node.title: Re^2: Warn if STDIN pipe is missing or unwanted
node.author: Anonymous Monk
node.doctext: Because different commands have different syntaxes/semtantics and after running other commands, I sometimes use the wrong syntax on the script in question. When that happens the script can either exit without processing the onput or hang waiting for input. Both cases seem like an error to me and if possible, should warn or fail.
